name: Blitz Telecom (Australia)
summary: Telecom reseller (Port Melbourne VIC; acquired Koala Telecom's business Aug 2007, then Wix/TelPacific/G-Node in 2007-08); collapsed into administration Jun 2008, customers sold to SuperNerd; domain later reused by AINS Telecommunications (BLITZ TELECOM OPERATIONS PTY LTD, ACN 123 769 880).

events.details: Blitz Telecom Operations Pty Ltd; acquired Koala Telecom business.

Collapsed into administration in Jun 2008, immediately after its buying spree (Wix, TelPacific, G-Node, Koala); customers sold to SuperNerd. Domain later served only a redirect (from Sep 2009), then hosted AINS Telecommunications (from ~2013).
